author: Yffe
content: SHIPPED + critic-clean (bcd5ede C7 + a7f743a parse_u64 strengthening). Built-in Option/Result construct (Some/None/Ok/Err reuse the enum machinery), Result<T,E> two-arg type, payload-in-contract via spec-match-in-ens (ens match result { Some(v) => ..., None => true }), and parse_u64 STRENGTHENED to caller-usable (all_digits(s) && in-range ==> result is Some && round-trip; None ==> !all_digits || empty || overflow) + the owned-String &s exec auto-ref. Critic NO DIVERGENCE: payload projection genuine (wrong payload -> L0), parse_u64 no-cheat (34-verified golden, wrong-value fails, Some-guarantee mutation-killable -> L3), owned-String auto-ref sound, oracle-compare R-CHAR-3-honest. External oracle landed (option_result + parse_u64 .th/.cert.json/.verus.rs goldens, #100). 605 tests. Deferred: #101 (§7 equivalent-mutant exclusion, surfaced by forced-None refusal); combinators + ? (ergonomic).
